note: Reusable components of the enterprise service layer. Selecting a subset here is what switching industry means: the same code assembles a different service from this registry plus an enterprise profile.

summary.zh: 把珠宝与硬木两套工艺规则、设备能力包和已授权纹样库做成可检索的知识底座，回答“能不能做、哪里不能做、怎么改”。
summary.en: Searchable base of craft rules, workshop capability envelopes and licensed patterns for both industries; answers whether a design can be made, where it fails and what to change.

summary.zh: 把概念事实、工艺判定与价格政策组合成可追溯的报价草稿，并给客户解释每一项金额的来源。
summary.en: Turns concept facts, the manufacturability verdict and pricing policy into a traceable quote draft and explains where every amount comes from.

summary.zh: 订单到工艺单、BOM、工序路线与发货状态机，每个状态迁移落一条哈希链台账事件。
summary.en: Order to work order, bill of materials, process route and shipment state machine; every transition appends a hash chained ledger event.

summary.zh: 按车间工作日排产，已承诺工单向后占位、新订单向前填谷，给出交期、档期与被拒绝的备选。
summary.en: Plans per workshop working day: committed work orders book backwards, new orders fill forwards, and every promise carries its slot and the rejected alternatives.

summary.zh: 缺陷分类、测量公差、抽样方案与判定不变量；争议可引用本工单的检验记录作为证据。
summary.en: Defect taxonomy, measurement tolerance, sampling plans and the verdict invariant; a dispute can cite inspections recorded against its own work order.

summary.zh: 多语站点询盘进入后做确定性打分、SLA 计时、归属路由、跟进任务与报价草稿，形成可测试的闭环。
summary.en: Site inquiries become deterministically scored leads with an SLA clock, owner routing, follow-up tasks and a quote draft, forming a testable closed loop.

summary.zh: 从站点合同生成多语页面、canonical、hreflang 与 JSON-LD；页面是数据的投影，改文案不改代码。
summary.en: Generates multilingual pages, canonical paths, hreflang alternates and JSON-LD from the site contract; pages are a projection of data, so copy changes are not code changes.

summary.zh: 逐页检查标题与描述长度、唯一 H1、canonical、hreflang 互指、结构化数据可解析，输出 0-10000 的分数与问题清单。
summary.en: Checks title and description length, a single H1, canonical paths, reciprocal hreflang and parseable structured data per page, then scores the site from 0 to 10000 bp.

summary.zh: 双守护角色设定、可复算的视觉资产库、脚本到成片的短剧工作流，全部以数据表达并可离线重建。
summary.en: Dual guardian bible, a recomputable visual asset library and a script to final cut short drama workflow, all expressed as data and rebuildable offline.

summary.zh: 授权文件集、四类衍生商品的材质与质量规格、抽样与标识要求，以及内容审核与真实性标注记录。
summary.en: Licence document set, bills of materials and quality specifications for four derivative categories, sampling and labelling rules, plus content review and authenticity records.
